limits: This checks a computational screening threshold, not material/device performance, safety or synthesizability. Actual Omnigent choice, timeout enforcement and frozen holdout validation remain separate.
registration_context: Follow-up sensitivity analysis specified in the agreed technical plan; this execution protocol is frozen after viewing the first discovery result and before computing any threshold-sensitivity outcomes.
reporting: Report all three grid points; 0.05 remains the main endpoint. Never select the most significant grid point to replace the main endpoint. Discovery sensitivity points are correlated, not independent replication.
representative_rule: Reuse the frozen representative composition table; no reselection by threshold or gap.
scientific_status_rules: Reuse original sample/coverage/degeneracy/interval rules independently for each grid point; missing bounds remain required.
selection_mode: human-approved scientific engineering integration; no autonomous Omnigent selection claimed
selection_reason: The first discovery screen has only nine passing compositions. Test whether the observed family ordering changes across the predeclared energy-above-hull thresholds.
